name: Social-dominance share leadership — long coins with an elevated relative-attention share (~1-week)
rationale: FRESH, NON-OBVIOUS hypothesis from an unbiased cross-asset lead-lag scan (cosmu/research/social_dominance_scan.py, 30-coin universe, ~1000 PIT daily bars each). The scan probed the DEEP, scale-stable LunarCrush cross-sectional ATTENTION SHARES that no spec rests on yet: social_dominance = a coin's % share of ALL crypto social volume. Unlike raw social_volume (drifts ~160x over 2020-26, so a fitted level floor is always-true — the phase0 §4 trap) and unlike social_volume_accel (probed DEAD on this universe: |t|<=1.1 at every horizon), the within-asset TRAILING z of social_dominance LEADS the cross-sectional forward return UP, monotonically in horizon: decile-spread t=+1.97 (k=1), +2.77 (k=2), +2.68 (k=3), +2.94 (k=5), +3.00 (k=7) — a SLOW ~1-week relative-attention-rotation continuation, distinct from absolute crowding (the registry's social_attention_z prior says elevated ABSOLUTE volume z leads DOWN; here elevated relative SHARE leads UP). The day-over-day CHANGE of dominance carries no signal (t~0) — it is the sustained elevated SHARE (z), not the jump, that pays. We enter LONG (spot-only, no shorts on Binance spot) when social_dom_z is HIGH (the coin owns an unusually large slice of crowd attention for its own recent history) AND own-price momentum is not already broken, and hold to the ~1-week horizon where the edge lives. DISCONFIRMER 1 (MANDATORY — subsumption): social_dominance co-moves with price (a coin getting more attention is often a coin that has already moved). A pre-registered DOUBLE-SORT holding 7d price-momentum ~fixed collapsed the spread to t=+0.20 (k=5) / +1.03 (k=7) — so the hypothesis is FALSIFIED if a momentum-ONLY control arm (drop social_dom_z, keep only ret_Nd) matches or beats its deflated Sharpe: then social_dom_z adds no orthogonal information and the 'attention share' story is just momentum. DISCONFIRMER 2 (relative vs absolute): swapping social_dom_z for the absolute social_volume_accel control must NOT match it — else it is the absolute level, not the relative share, that pays (and the absolute control already probed dead). DISCONFIRMER 3 (placebo): a within-asset time-shuffled social_dom_z (same marginal distribution, scrambled timing) must NOT reproduce the edge. tier1 + low-confidence until validated OOS — the Gate down-weights until it earns its place. PRIOR (honest): the double-sort already predicts disconfirmer 1 will likely FIRE; this is authored so the deterministic Gate disposes, not to be tuned to pass.
catalyst: a coin's share of total crypto social attention is elevated vs its own recent history; relative-strength rotation continues over the following week
